title: An Empirical Study on the Bugs Found while Reusing Pre-trained Natural Language Processing Models
reasoning: The paper is a software engineering study that identifies and classifies bugs, root causes, and impacts in pre-trained NLP models (including LLMs like GPT-2 and T5) by mining GitHub issues. While it discusses fairness and bias as a source of model issues, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
